# Biology Exam Countdown Plan

A focused 14-day plan for a high school student with **90 minutes on weekdays** and **3 hours on weekends**. It prioritizes **cell structure, genetics, and ecology**, with built-in active recall and a final full review day.

## 14-Day Study Roadmap

| Day | Time | Focus | Key Sessions | Goal |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | 90 min | Cell basics | Cell theory; prokaryotic vs eukaryotic cells; organelle functions | Build core vocabulary |
| Day 2 | 90 min | Cell structure | Membrane, nucleus, mitochondria, ribosomes, ER, Golgi, lysosomes | Label and explain each part |
| Day 3 | 90 min | Cell transport | Diffusion, osmosis, active transport, homeostasis | Compare transport processes |
| Day 4 | 90 min | Cell review | Mixed questions; diagrams; flashcards | Check weak spots in cells |
| Day 5 | 90 min | Genetics intro | DNA, genes, chromosomes, traits, alleles | Understand inheritance terms |
| Day 6 | 3 hours | Genetics practice | Punnett squares; dominant/recessive; genotype vs phenotype; meiosis basics | Solve genetics problems accurately |
| Day 7 | 3 hours | Genetics review | Dihybrid crosses; mutations; pedigree-style questions; mixed quiz | Strengthen exam-style skills |
| Day 8 | 90 min | Ecology basics | Ecosystems, populations, communities, biomes, habitats | Learn ecosystem levels |
| Day 9 | 90 min | Energy flow | Food chains, food webs, producers/consumers/decomposers, trophic levels | Trace energy movement |
| Day 10 | 90 min | Cycles and balance | Water, carbon, nitrogen cycles; biodiversity; population changes | Connect cycles to ecosystems |
| Day 11 | 3 hours | Ecology practice | Data graphs; environmental impact; conservation; mixed ecology questions | Apply concepts to scenarios |
| Day 12 | 90 min | Mixed retrieval | Cells + genetics + ecology flashcards; short-answer practice | Improve recall speed |
| Day 13 | 90 min | Mock test | Timed practice set; mark mistakes; fix top 3 gaps | Simulate exam conditions |
| Day 14 | 3 hours | Final 1-day review | Full-topic recap; error log; formula/vocabulary sweep; calm final check | Enter exam ready and confident |

## Daily Study Structure and Active Recall

Use this simple format every day so each session stays efficient.

### Weekday session: 90 minutes
- 10 min: Quick recap from memory without notes
- 25 min: Learn or review the topic
- 25 min: Active recall practice
- 20 min: Practice questions or diagram labeling
- 10 min: Error log and 3 key takeaways

### Weekend session: 3 hours
- 15 min: Memory warm-up
- 45 min: Topic review
- 45 min: Active recall drills
- 45 min: Practice questions, diagrams, or data interpretation
- 20 min: Mark answers and correct mistakes
- 10 min: Final summary from memory

### Active recall techniques to use
- **Blurting**: write everything you remember about a topic, then check notes
- **Flashcards**: term on one side, definition/process/example on the other
- **Teach-back**: explain a concept out loud as if teaching a younger student
- **Diagram labeling**: redraw cells, DNA, or food webs from memory
- **Question swaps**: turn notes into “why,” “how,” and “compare” questions
- **Timed mini-quizzes**: 5–10 questions with no notes
- **Error log**: keep a list of missed questions and revisit it every 2–3 days

## Final 1-Day Review Plan

### Day 14: Full Review Day
- 30 min: Cell structure recap from memory
- 30 min: Genetics recap from memory
- 30 min: Ecology recap from memory
- 30 min: Mixed quiz under timed conditions
- 20 min: Review wrong answers and write corrections
- 20 min: Redraw key diagrams: cell, Punnett square, food web
- 20 min: Flashcard sweep of all weak terms
- 20 min: Final confidence pass: definitions, common mistakes, and exam strategies

### What to prioritize on the last day
- Organelles and their functions
- DNA, genes, alleles, genotype, phenotype
- Punnett squares and inheritance patterns
- Food chains, food webs, and energy transfer
- Cycles, biodiversity, and human impact on ecosystems

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Make flashcards] https://quizlet.com/
Action: [Button: Practice biology] https://www.khanacademy.org/science/biology
Action: [Button: Try questions] https://www.bbc.co.uk/bitesize/subjects/z2pfb9q

## Sources

- Biology study support: https://www.khanacademy.org/science/biology
- Revision practice: https://www.bbc.co.uk/bitesize/subjects/z2pfb9q
- Flashcard tool: https://quizlet.com/
